facts: SDK base replacement targets mhome.carolgames.com and points it at gxbsdk
engine/update replacements target xuemeien.carolgames.com:9000 plus historical engine IPs
web/CDN activity domains game168.tw/girls.game168.com.tw were also redirected to gxbengine
UpdateScene calls a center/v1 endpoint with MID20480
center response sets xyd.serverUrl from response.url
same center response sets xyd.resDownloadUrl from response.res_download_url
normal gameplay HTTP uses xyd.serverUrl or misc.webAPIURL
lazy asset URLs are built from xyd.resDownloadUrl
TCP endpoint is dynamically discovered through MID192 rather than hardcoded in UpdateScene

conclusion: Original deployment exposed distinct SDK/auth, center/discovery, gameplay API, resource-download/CDN, and dynamically discovered TCP roles. Exact physical server/process separation is not recoverable, but collapsing these front doors onto one reconstruction host can create contention the original deployment may not have had.
